_about: Translation rules: real deeds -> XP and temper (attribute growth). Edit numbers here, never in code. After any change run: python3 engine/darrow.py sync

levels._formula: XP to reach level L = 50 * L * (L - 1)
levels._about: The ladder runs past the Unkneeling on purpose. Unbowed (level 25) is this saga's summit: at a Costly pace it lies beyond the finale, at a Hard-won pace or better it lands about where the knee is whole again, so the comeback's quality decides whether he earns the name before Book VI ends. Warden of the Ember (level 30) belongs to what comes after: the sequels' rank. Resolve passing the Knight Who Fell early is by design (the GM file: he will not notice when he does).

attributes._formula: score = base + floor(sqrt(temper / divisor)), then capped by the Knots of the Binding

caps_by_knots._about: Highest score an attribute can show for a given number of Knots tied. Temper earned above the cap is banked and released when the next Knot ties.

sport_session._about: One award per sport_log session a day (the session column: A/B/C/film/test/review), up to per_day_cap; a session's skill rows count once for XP and temper, and each skill's Art practice counts separately.
sport_session.label: Sport skill session

floor_7_of_7.label: Floor minimum every day of the week

week_score._about: 0-100. Sets the chapter's outcome tier. Red-light days (plan says rest) are excused, not counted against. roll_mod rides every climax die; target_odds is the chance of a full success each climax check is set to have (the brief prints the DC that gives it, from his modifiers that week: darrow.py odds), so a strong week's checks are very likely and a thin week's are even, and the dice can still fail.

overshoot._about: Golden rule 6: work past the plan is logged truthfully and pays nothing. From this date on: a knee session the day after another, knee or upper sessions beyond the week's planned count, optional add-ons beyond once a week or before their start date (real/config.json -> weekly_template.optional_from), and conditioning minutes past the plan's ceiling (real/config.json -> conditioning.cap_min). Earlier days keep what they paid, so nothing the page has shown changes.

ember._about: Rolling 7-day fuel score, 0-100, from logged days only. Day fuel = kcal_weight*(kcal/target)^exp + protein_weight*(protein/target)^exp, each ratio capped at 1.

inspiration._about: Cap on held Inspiration. Earned by a week with the daily minimum every day (weekly.floor_7_of_7), a Triumph week (weekly.triumph_inspiration), and every level gained from per_level_from on (per_level each); spent with `darrow.py inspire`.

tether._about: The Tether: time together on purpose, logged as daily_log.csv -> together=Y (nothing else about it is recorded, and it is never scored). Its stage is the count of such days against `stages`, like an Art's ranks, and it only ever climbs: a quiet week is a thread at rest, never a thread frayed. No XP, no temper. The sheet shows it from stage I; each stage unlocks one planned scene (saga/bible/_gm/arc.md -> rae.tether). Her regard is story-only and moves by choices alone.

works._about: The works: real goals outside the knee, run in 2-5 tasks (real/projects.json, `darrow.py project`). No XP and no temper: the Reckoning is the leg's. A finished project counts in the sheet's WORKS and brings inspiration_per_finished Inspiration (capped like the rest); its tale (saga/bible/_gm/tales.md) pays a piece per task and a keepsake at the end. Only the counts reach the sheet and the site.

tags._about: Which real practice feeds which Art. Exercise-log 'block' and 'session' values map to tags here.

arts.name: The Seated Blade
arts.effect: Fight at full Might from a fixed position; no penalty for being unable to move.

arts.name: Iron Grip
arts.effect: Cannot be disarmed; advantage to bind and hold a blade.

arts.name: Hammerfall
arts.effect: One blow per fight that staggers whatever it lands on.

arts.name: Stillwater Stance
arts.effect: Advantage to keep footing; cannot be knocked down while braced.

arts.name: The Long Breath
arts.effect: Recover once per fight; endure where others tire.

arts.name: The Mender's Patience
arts.effect: +Rank to Resolve checks against fear, haste and temptation.

arts.name: Warden's Eye
arts.effect: Read a weakness or a lie; +Rank to Insight.

arts.name: Groundbreaker
arts.effect: Drive through a line; Might checks on foot gain +Rank.

arts.name: Soft Landing
arts.effect: Take falls and drops without harm.

arts.name: The Long Road
arts.effect: Travel and pursue without exhaustion.

arts.name: Thunderstep
arts.effect: Leap gaps, walls and horses.

arts.name: Hawk's Stoop
arts.effect: Close any distance before a bow can be drawn twice.

arts.name: Anchor
arts.effect: Stop dead at full speed; break a charge.

arts.name: The Turning Blade
arts.effect: Turn at speed and strike from the turn.

arts.name: The Quickening
arts.effect: Act before the enemy finishes deciding.

sport_arts._about: Set by /sport (10/9): maps a sport_log 'skill' (config.json -> sport.skills) to an Art. knot = the Knot from which the skill's first phase of practice opens (real/plan/sport_plan.md section 3); practice before it is banked.

arts.name: The Measured Hand
arts.effect: Whatever he throws lands where he means it to, at the pace he means: a blade into a friend's palm, a stone that only taps the shutter. Advantage to place a thrown thing.

arts.name: The Wicket Gate
arts.effect: Thread a thrown or passed thing past a man standing in its way; a guard in the line stops it only if he wins a contest for it.

arts.name: The Liar's Shoulder
arts.effect: Sell a false intention with the body. Once per scene, a foe who reads him commits the wrong way: advantage on the next check against that foe.

arts.name: Overwall
arts.effect: Throw over a shield, a wall or a crowd and drop it into the space behind; what stands between him and the mark gives it no cover.

arts.name: The Far Cast
arts.effect: A long throw a running ally can take: the rope across the river, the sword across the hall, landing where the runner will be.

arts.name: Tell-Reading
arts.effect: Watch a foe's hips and hands and know his next move before he makes it. Once per scene, ask what an opponent means to do.

arts.name: The Shadow-Step
arts.effect: Mirror a foe and stay between him and what he wants: advantage to hold a doorway, cut off a flight, or shadow a duelist step for step.

knots.name: The Knot of Straightening
knots.proves: the leg can be made straight
knots.allows: the leg lies straight on the blanket; he is carried, or on crutches; nothing on the leg

knots.name: The Knot of Walking
knots.allows: walks on his own legs on the flat: the hall, the court, the wall-walk by the gate; no stair down, no running, no fight on his feet, nothing that tests the Binding (the soft season: the quiet is a liar)

knots.name: The Knot of Standing
knots.allows: stands and bears weight on the leg: a stair with a hand on the wall, the forms standing; still no running, no leap, no fight on his feet

knots.name: The Knot of the Road
knots.allows: runs on the flat and on the road; no hard landing, no sprint, no turning at speed

knots.name: The Knot of Lightning
knots.proves: it can leap, land, sprint and stop
knots.allows: leaps, lands, sprints and stops dead; not yet the turn at speed

knots.name: The Knot of Turning
knots.proves: it can turn at speed: the movement that broke it
knots.allows: turns at speed and fights on his feet; the movement that broke it is his again

knots.name: The Knot of the Field
knots.allows: whole for battle: nothing the leg may not do

knots_about: `allows`: what the page may let the leg do once this Knot is tied, in story terms (the brief prints the tied Knot's line; the real plan clears the real knee, never the story)
